title: Legacy map for suite beta8-213d

legacy.title: Beta.8 empirical-route fixture debt (#213, 213d)
legacy.description: Synthetic positives on distinct context axes, independent controls and single-property twins that bring seven T2 families (databricks, legacy Datadog application key, mailchimp, mailgun, okta, openai, postman) to the stable-empirical fixture cells, and close the #206 positive/context debt #207 left on atlassian, firebase and supabase. Values are synthetic or independently constructed, never provider-issued; no observation record is implied, and disputed grammar properties (redact-secret#694, #697-#701) are never negative expectations.
